ticket.subject: Urgent: duplicate invoice charge
ticket.body: I am new to billing. How do I review an invoice and request a refund for a duplicate charge?

corpus.title: Synthetic billing guide (not real product policy)
passages: Review the invoice identifier and charge history before requesting a refund for a duplicate charge.
In this synthetic billing system, a refund request includes the invoice identifier and a short explanation.

passages: A password reset link is available on the login screen.
